profile.text: Previously an independent assassin employed at Rhodes Island as a specialist operator, Operator Phantom had achieved his original goal for joining us by the time he returned from his stint as a Wrankwood actor. After discussion with the Doctor, he has agreed to continue his cooperation with us, providing support for nearby Rhodes Island offices on his travels throughout Terra.
